title: Arithmetic and geometric sequences
stem: An arithmetic sequence has second term u₂ = 7 and fifth term u₅ = 16. A geometric sequence has first term v₁ = u₁ and common ratio r, where 0 < r < 1.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the common difference d and the first term u₁.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the sum of the first 20 terms of the arithmetic sequence.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: The sum to infinity of the geometric sequence is 16. Find r.

parts.label: d
parts.prompt: Find the smallest value of n for which uₙ > 100.
parts.notes: Answers of n = 33 show the common error of treating > as ≥; award M1 A0.

title: Powers and roots of a complex number

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Write z in the form r cis θ, where r > 0 and −π < θ ≤ π.

parts.label: b
markscheme: De Moivre: z⁶ = 2⁶ cis(6 × π/3) / 64 cis 2π

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Solve w³ = z, giving your answers in the form r cis θ, where r > 0 and −π < θ ≤ π.
parts.notes: Award the final A1 only if all three arguments lie in −π < θ ≤ π.

parts.label: d
parts.prompt: Show that the sum of the three solutions in part (c) is zero.
markscheme: the solutions are the roots of w³ + 0w² + 0w − z = 0 / they form an equilateral triangle centred at the origin
sum of roots = −(coefficient of w²)/1 = 0 / vectors from the centre cancel by symmetry
